aggressive_definition: Advanced incident prostate cancer, defined as stage III/IV; stage IV was also analyzed separately.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: From 1986 to 2003, 3,362 prostate cancers were identified, including 1,164 advanced (stage III/IV) cancers.
study_design: Prospective case-cohort analysis within the Netherlands Cohort Study
reason: The abstract analyzes incident overall prostate cancer and advanced stage III/IV and stage IV prostate cancer. Although the source cohort included 58,279 men, the analytic case-cohort sample size is not reported.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Hazard ratios of stage III/IV and stage IV prostate cancer for the highest versus the lowest category of black tea consumption (≥5 versus ≤1 cups/day) were 0.75 (95% confidence interval: 0.59, 0.97) and 0.67 (95% confidence interval: 0.50, 0.91), respectively.
estimate_classifications.reason: The row's HR of 0.75 is explicitly reported for incident advanced stage III/IV prostate cancer, comparing at least 5 with at most 1 cups/day of black tea.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
